question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5dd3caf613c76825c35a30d8124ee2c46f5d679bfabe2281ffc2e7ad5c68004.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00d310602d53b43bb8d3172f23fa7a466bb660b0761cc01354acb42f7caf9f3d.png] 

⇒ (6 + 2)2 = 64

⇒ 8² = 64

⇒ 64 = 64 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c09fae26c8559010da05f3121e0173f0a64259bd88292862e9fa01b5ecb7df67.png] 

⇒ (4 + 3)2 = 49

⇒ 72 = 49

⇒ 49 = 49 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47cf0d9046832e0b887e8c21af8877ce61f2f011526b5c1878eddc305f5f7722.png] 

⇒ (2 + 3)2 = ?

⇒ 52 = ?

⇒ **25 = ?**

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
